shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A woman in a navy blazer sits at the screen-side window seat and asks about the preliminary agenda, while a woman in a emerald blouse sits at the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.

shots.content: A man in a mustard sweater enters, takes the door-side window seat, and asks for the revenue update, while a woman in a navy blazer sits at the screen-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a navy blazer answers.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the presentation-screen end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the glass door, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.
